en.text: Listen to my prayer, God. my supplication.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，求你留心听我的祷告，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你留心聽我的禱告，

en.text: Attend to me, and answer me. in my complaint, and moan

zhSimplified.text: 求你侧耳听我，应允我。

zhTraditional.text: 求你側耳聽我，應允我。

en.text: because of the voice of the enemy, of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

zhSimplified.text: 都因仇敌的声音，恶人的欺压；

zhTraditional.text: 都因仇敵的聲音，惡人的欺壓；

en.text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

zhSimplified.text: 我心在我里面甚是疼痛；

zhTraditional.text: 我心在我裏面甚是疼痛；

en.text: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. has overwhelmed me.

zhSimplified.text: 恐惧战兢归到我身；

zhTraditional.text: 恐懼戰兢歸到我身；

en.text: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! and be at rest.

zhSimplified.text: 我说：但愿我有翅膀像鸽子，

zhTraditional.text: 我說：但願我有翅膀像鴿子，

en.text: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.”

zhSimplified.text: 我必远游，

zhTraditional.text: 我必遠遊，

en.text: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

zhSimplified.text: 我必速速逃到避所，

zhTraditional.text: 我必速速逃到避所，

en.text: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, have seen violence and strife in the city.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，求你吞灭他们，变乱他们的舌头！

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，求你吞滅他們，變亂他們的舌頭！

en.text: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. and abuse are also within her.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在城墙上昼夜绕行；

zhTraditional.text: 他們在城牆上晝夜繞行；

en.text: Destructive forces are within her. and lies don’t depart from her streets.

zhSimplified.text: 邪恶在其中；

zhTraditional.text: 邪惡在其中；

en.text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

zhSimplified.text: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我，

zhTraditional.text: 原來不是仇敵辱罵我，

en.text: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

zhSimplified.text: 不料是你；你原与我平等，

zhTraditional.text: 不料是你；你原與我平等，

en.text: We took sweet fellowship together. in God’s house with company.

zhSimplified.text: 我们素常彼此谈论，以为甘甜；

zhTraditional.text: 我們素常彼此談論，以為甘甜；

en.text: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

footnotes.text: 55:15 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 愿死亡忽然临到他们！

zhTraditional.text: 願死亡忽然臨到他們！

en.text: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

zhSimplified.text: 至于我，我要求告 神；

zhTraditional.text: 至於我，我要求告上帝；

en.text: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

zhSimplified.text: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀声悲叹；

zhTraditional.text: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀聲悲歎；

en.text: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, me.

zhSimplified.text: 他救赎我命脱离攻击我的人， 人甚多。

zhTraditional.text: 他救贖我命脫離攻擊我的人， 人甚多。

en.text: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. They never change and don’t fear God.

zhSimplified.text: 那没有更变、不敬畏 神的人，

zhTraditional.text: 那沒有更變、不敬畏上帝的人，

en.text: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

zhSimplified.text: 他背了约，

zhTraditional.text: 他背了約，

en.text: His mouth was smooth as butter, his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

zhSimplified.text: 他的口如奶油光滑，

zhTraditional.text: 他的口如奶油光滑，

en.text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

zhSimplified.text: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华，

zhTraditional.text: 你要把你的重擔卸給耶和華，

en.text: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你必使恶人下入灭亡的坑；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你必使惡人下入滅亡的坑；
